segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The system's been solid for us on this fleet for as long as I've used it, so I issued the ALI to the ramp pretty much as generated.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant accepted an automated instruction for atypical cargo without the available manual cross-check, relying on the system's general reliability.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I logged it and kept moving, because we still had the last-minute change to deal with.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a continuation decision under time pressure, without a hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I looked at the total weight and it was basically in line with the LMCs we'd been getting all week on this route... So I cleared it on that basis.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant used aggregate weight similarity instead of evaluating the placement-specific index impact of the aft hold assignment.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Two in a row felt like enough to say something was going on with how this rotation was trending that day, so I built in a forward shift.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant inferred a recurring causal rotation pattern from two unrelated prior events and overrode the current flight's own computed index.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I signed and released with the figures as they stood. I weighed the delay risk against a one-bag discrepancy.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The generation specification leaves this operational tradeoff neutral and professionally defensible.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, all 3 positive segments are detected with 0 false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At the recommended threshold, 2 of 3 hidden instances are strict true positives. The substitution instance has correct localization and mechanism but the wrong primary taxonomy label.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At the recommended threshold, all 3 hidden instances are mechanism-first true positives with no false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention in the RAG output, but counting candidates as detections creates one false alarm on the neutral final-sign-off episode.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor taxonomy error: Representativeness heuristic was used instead of the hidden Substitution bias label.
Candidate inclusion produces a false alarm for plan continuation bias on an intentionally neutral decision episode.
The correlation finding is only moderate confidence and is missed at the high-only threshold.
main_strengths: All three identified findings use valid transcript evidence.
All identified findings localize to the correct decision episodes.
The stated mechanisms and reasoning operations are substantively accurate, including the mislabeled substitution finding.
The system appropriately kept the ambiguous final sign-off issue as a candidate rather than an identified bias.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has perfect segment-level detection and perfect mechanism-first identification at the recommended threshold, but lower strict performance because one correct mechanism is assigned a near-neighbor label. Candidate-level inclusion reduces precision by flagging a neutral episode.
